pkgmetadata.longdescription: Provisions FreedomNAS onto a dedicated disk, or onto the system that is already running. Every OS command it issues — including the chroot invocation and the contents of distribution-specific configuration files — comes from freedomnas-profiles through the engine, so the installer itself contains no distribution-specific logic. Pre-built images remain the primary install path; this covers hardware that cannot be flashed, console installs, and adopting an existing system.
